subject: Post-call recap + proposed next-step plan for Beacon Retail
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Langley <ava.langley@beaconretail.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@beaconretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next-step plan for Beacon Retail

Hi Ava / Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a concrete set of next steps so we all have the same view. I captured the short list in the attached workbook (BR-MAP-v1.xlsx).

Key pain & goals (from our call)
- High latency on personalization API during peak windows (cart/checkout) causing ~5–8% drop in conversion.
- Current ML infra is cost-prohibitive at scale; team wants a 30–40% TCO reduction target.
- Need strict data residency controls for EU customers and audit trail for vendor access.

Success criteria (what Beacon needs to sign off on pilot)
1) End-to-end inference latency < 120ms p95 for 512-token sequences
2) < 35% projected unit-cost reduction vs current baseline (pre-prod estimate)
3) Security checklist: SOC2 evidence + VPC deployment option + KMS integration

Proposed mutual action plan (high level) — owners and dates
- Week 1 (Sep 21) — Onboarding call + infra questionnaire (Owner: Jonas Weber)
- Week 2 (Sep 28) — Pilot environment provisioned (Dedicated pool) + sample workload run (Owner: Monica Patel)
- Week 3 (Oct 5) — Quant report: latency/cost projection & tuning recommendations (Owner: Grace O'Connor)
- Week 4 (Oct 12) — Executive review & decision to expand to production pilot (Owners: Ava + Beacon execs; Redwood exec: Jonas)

Decision process & stakeholders
- Procurement (Tom) will own contracting timeline and PO issuance.
- Engineering (Ava) will validate perf and security controls during the pilot.
- Legal / Security may request SOC2 / KMS attestation — Redwood will share evidence during Week 2.

Immediate asks from Beacon
- Confirm target decision date (we penciled Oct 12)
- Share procurement contact (if different from Tom) for contracting cadence

Attachments: BR-MAP-v1.xlsx (high-level milestones + owner matrix), redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (pilot estimate).

If this looks right I’ll send an updated MAP with a calendar invite for the Week 1 onboarding.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Ava Langley <ava.langley@beaconretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@beaconretail.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next-step plan for Beacon Retail

Thanks Jonas — this is very helpful and matches what we discussed. Two quick notes: 

1) Decision date: we prefer Oct 8 for the exec review (earlier) if possible — our Q4 budget window closes mid-October. Can Redwood accelerate the Quant report to Oct 1?
2) Procurement: loop in procurement@beaconretail.com (I've cc'ed Tom but procurement handles PO and contract language).

We’re good with the scope you outlined. Please bump the Quant report to Oct 1 if you can; otherwise Oct 5 is acceptable but may push our internal sign-off.

Ava Langley
Head of ML Platform, Beacon Retail
ava.langley@beaconretail.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next-step plan for Beacon Retail — updated dates & MFU

Thanks Ava — we can accommodate the earlier milestone. Updated plan below and a small change in owners to speed delivery:

Revised dates (per Beacon request)
- Week 1 (Sep 21) — Onboarding call + infra questionnaire (Owner: Jonas Weber) — completed
- Week 2 (Sep 28) — Pilot environment provisioned + smoke run (Owner: Monica Patel)
- Week 3 (Oct 01) — Quant report & tuning recommendations (Owner: Monica Patel + Grace O'Connor)
- Week 4 (Oct 08) — Executive review & decision (Beacon)

Notes / risks
- To hit Oct 1 for the Quant report we’ll need sample traces and a short workload (1000 live requests or a 1-hour replay) by Sep 22. Can your team confirm availability?
- Procurement: we’ll send a preliminary SOW and pilot pricing this week (redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf). Expect a DocuSign packet when procurement signals readiness.

I’m looping in Monica (CS lead) and Grace (SE) to own the environment build and the quant analysis. Monica — could you confirm you can run the sample replay and deliver the report by Oct 1 if Beacon provides traces by Sep 22?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites for the onboarding call and the Quant checkpoint.

Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

We’ve also locked Oct 8 for the exec review. Ava will coordinate internal attendees. Once we receive the DocuSign link we’ll prioritize review — target to return an executed PO within 7 business days of receiving the SOW.

Tom Keller
